text:
yun: Heads-up: Partner 'Corsair Compute' wants a cross-validated perf/W benchmark with our 20B model on their new C-Edge boards. They asked for a lightweight plan doc to align on data, ownership, and announcement gating.
samir: thanks. target metrics? Corsair asked for throughput (seq=4096 streaming), steady-state perf/W, and kernel stability across a 2-hour run. Also per-core thermal traces.
yun: exact. propose: 2 runs per config (baseline redwood default kernel, corsair-tuned-kernel), 2h each, with 15-minute warmup, power sampled at 1s, thermal at 5s.
kai_ops: infra notes: we'll spin up 3 identical perf nodes in perf-pool, dedicated VLAN, and an isolated collector. Ensure time sync and NTP drift checks.
nina_pm: partner asks for a reproducible artifact so their QA can re-run. we should standardize on docker tag + config bundle.
samir: Corsair side will provide: board firmware image id, kernel tweak script (cc: corsair-ops), and IPMI endpoints. we'll ask them for a minimal docs.yaml with env vars.
yun: draft run id scheme:
RUN_ID="corsair-C-EDGE-2026-05-12-01"
TAGS=("corsair" "perfW" "20B" "streaming")
kai_ops: collector schema must include run_id, tagset, avg_power_w, power_std_w, tokens_per_sec, latency_p95_ms, kernel_label, firmware_id, thermal_max_c. also include raw_power_series_url.
samir: we'll also track kernel panics/logs in a zipped artifact. add panic_count to the schema.
partner-bot: lab booking suggestion: 2026-05-12 02:00 PT or 2026-05-12 20:00 PT. Please confirm.
yun: prefer 20:00 PT to avoid daytime lab traffic. partner-bot: confirm slot.
partner-bot: booking confirmed: corsair-lab-bay-4 reserved 2026-05-12T20:00:00-07:00 for 3h. booking_id=CB-59182
nina_pm: comms ask: Corsair would like a "no surprises" embargo window 3 business days after we share verified numbers. Legal ok?
yun: legal green flagged embargo for co-announces. we'll require a 72h review.
kai_ops: risk items: GPU thermal plateauing after 90m, IPMI disconnects, firmware auto-updates. mitigation: disable auto-update, enable watchdog, and run a preflight flash.
samir: Corsair will run a kernel stability test (stress-ng variant) before official runs. we'll mirror that harness to be symmetric.
yun: partner wants a marketplace blurb if numbers pass: "Redwood Inference + Corsair: optimized 20B throughput per watt". Marketing to draft.
nina_pm: I'll prepare a reproducibility bundle scaffold: docker-compose.yml, env.sample, run.sh, metrics-mapping.json. We'll drop it in experiments/corsair/ and share link.
yun: final action list: yun -> coord + partner comms; samir -> kernel scripts + logs collector; kai_ops -> infra + schema; nina_pm -> reproducibility bundle + comms. target dry-run: 2026-05-10 09:00 PT; official run: 2026-05-12 20:00 PT.
partner-bot: Reminder set: dry-run 2026-05-10T09:00:00-07:00. Reminder created.
yun: thanks team. I'll post a short runbook after partner confirms the final kernel label.
